about: The ID registry (Book 2 section 04), seeded in Stage 1 from Books 4 to 11. origin "stated": the ID is written in a book; "expanded": written as a shorthand such as X_A/B; "assigned": given in Stage 1 to an entity a book names, following Book 2 prefixes and the books' own naming. ref is copied verbatim from the book. IDs are stable forever: an assigned ID may be renamed, with a decision-log entry, only until content first uses it (Stage 3 onwards).
